terminal_record.title: TrumpFile claims a 2008 New York Times Epstein profile was arranged by Howard Rubenstein
terminal_record.description_short: TrumpFile claims a 2008 New York Times Epstein profile was arranged by Howard Rubenstein
terminal_record.description_medium: TrumpFile’s timeline page states that The New York Times published a flattering article about Jeffrey Epstein on January 3, 2008, and claims publicist Howard Rubenstein arranged the interview. It says his clients included Donald Trump and Jared Kushner. The page does not provide the NYT article or a supporting source link; the claimed client overlap does not establish Trump or Kushner influenced the coverage.
terminal_record.description_long: TrumpFile’s timeline page describes a purported New York Times article about Jeffrey Epstein as flattering and says publicist Howard Rubenstein arranged the interview. The page’s title assigns the item a January 3, 2008 date, and its text says Rubenstein’s client list also included the Trump and Kushner families, Rupert Murdoch, and Adnan Khashoggi. These are claims made by the supplied TrumpFile page, not independently established facts about the article or its preparation. The extracted page provides no link to the New York Times story or to evidence for the arrangement; it says source links would be added later. A client relationship, even if accurate, does not show that Trump or Kushner requested, shaped, or approved the coverage. The underlying article’s publication date, text, tone, and Rubenstein’s role remain unconfirmed. This internal draft preserves the page’s specific claim while identifying its limits. It removes the unrelated national-security and war tags and does not state that Trump influenced the article. Keep the entry publication-ineligible until the original article and claim-level documentation can be reviewed.
